result: LENA perturbs at small estimated gradients and shrinks the last step whenever the average movement exceeds a budget, which keeps SPIDER/STORM gradient estimates accurate without big batches; it finds (ε, ε_H)-approximate local minima with Õ(ε^{−3} + ε_H^{−6}) stochastic gradients, Õ(ε^{−3}) for ε_H = √ε.
result_plain: LENA: perturbed SPIDER/STORM with last-step shrinkage, Õ(ε^-3 + ε_H^-6) for approximate local minima.
